messages:
hana lee: FYI I opened a PR to add a "Warmstart vs Coldstart" runbook for Dedicated provisioning. It covers tenant warm pools, expected behavior when reserving capacity, and a canary rollout pattern. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/5312
jorge alvarez: Love this. Can we add a short flowchart or bullet checklist for engineers who need zero-downtime migrations?
tina nguyen: i'll draft a 3-step canary: 1) create warm pool, 2) migrate 5% of traffic, 3) monitor latency and error rates for 15m, 4) ramp. include metrics to watch (p50/p95 latency, throttles, 5xx).
hana lee: perfect. add the exact Grafana panels and alert queries if you can. Ops wants conservative thresholds.

```yaml
# example reserve (warm) pool
pool:
  name: warm-small
  size: 3
  mode: warm
```

jorge alvarez: also include CLI/SDK snippet for attaching a tenant to a warm pool. some customers will script this.

```bash
# attach tenant to pool
redwoodctl dedicated attach-tenant --tenant-id t-123 --pool warm-small
```

```python
# SDK attach example
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
c.pools.attach(tenant_id='t-123', pool_name='warm-small')
```

tina nguyen: added a note: attaching may trigger short KV cache priming. call it out as "brief latency bump (<=45s)" rather than outage. ops approved wording.
docs-bot: Lint: missing cross-link to /handbook/dedicated/observability.md and add changelog entry. Also flag: please include SDK minimum versions for code snippets.
hana lee: thanks docs-bot. i'll add SDK min: python SDK >=0.10.2, CLI >=1.14.0.
jorge alvarez: suggest adding a rollback play: detach tenant -> restore label mapping from backup -> confirm traffic returns. put commands inline.

```bash
# detach and restore
redwoodctl dedicated detach-tenant --tenant-id t-123
redwoodctl dedicated restore-tenant --backup backup-t123.yaml
```

ops-bot: Ops note: recommend running migration during low-impact windows and setting tenant priority to "low" temporarily if testing on shared capacity.
tina nguyen: i'll include a short troubleshooting section: if throttles persist >5m, escalate to eng-runtime and reference incident runbook.
hana lee: staging deploy queued. tagging docs@team and ops@team for quick review.
docs-bot: Reminder: add images as SVGs under handbook assets and reference using /assets/handbook/dedicated/warmstart.svg.
ops-bot: smoke test checklist: create warm pool 3 nodes, attach test tenant, generate 100rps for 10m, observe metrics. Post results here.
jorge alvarez: ran smoke test: observed ~30s cache priming with p95 latency spike ~120ms above baseline, throttles negligible. looks good.
hana lee: merging after one more editorial pass. small follow-up to add the flowchart. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
